gauntlet: done summary

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares addresses without first removing the final slash, so `/widgets/` does not match its page. A local reproduction showed the failure. A test confirmed this cause.

### How to fix it

The proposed fix removes the final slash before comparing addresses, which is expected to make `/widgets/` load. That work will be tracked in an existing ticket that already covers this concern, [widgets issue 42](https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42). No new ticket was created, and the tracker was not changed.
